nodes.summary: The Price equation (exact, finite population). Individual `i` has fitness `w i` (number of offspring), trait value `z i`, and mean offspring trait value `z' i`. With population means `w̄ = 𝔼 i, w i`, `z̄ = 𝔼 i, z i` and offspring mean trait `z̄' = ∑ i, w i * z' i / ∑ i, w i`, `w̄ (z̄' - z̄) = Cov(w, z) + E[w (z' - z)]`, where `Cov` is the population covariance (Price 1970).
